name: AutoHedge
description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
one_liner: A kit for building an AI-run trading bot that analyzes markets, decides trades, and executes them automatically on crypto exchanges — essentially a DIY robot hedge fund.
buyer: A crypto-native trader or small quant shop with real risk capital and technical skill who wants to automate parts of their trading process — not a retail beginner.
business_use_cases: A small crypto trading shop uses it as a starting framework to build and backtest their own automated Solana trading strategies faster.
A quant developer offers custom agent-based trading system builds to crypto funds, using this as the underlying architecture.
An educator builds a paid course teaching developers how multi-agent trading pipelines work, using this open-source project as the hands-on lab.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid custom strategy development and deployment services on top of the open-source framework for trading firms.

steal_this: Do not deploy this with live money as a weekend project — automated trading bots carry serious financial and regulatory risk. The safer build is a paper-trading dashboard that visualizes what this framework's agents would have done, as a portfolio piece.
